modeinfo: About these battles Ranked (Path of Legends): 270,458 usable battles from the players the collector sampled, not from every player. Training battles Sep 1 to Oct 22; test battles Oct 24 to Oct 26. Every mode and league has its own model, trained only on its own battles: the oldest 70% train it, the next 15% tune its settings and the newest 15% test it. 7 of 7 leagues have enough battles to build from; the others stay in the list but can't be picked.
